canonical_claim: GCS `CompleteMultipartUpload` silently ignores `x-goog-if-generation-match`, so conditional writes must not use multipart there; `Compose` enforces the precondition, making multipart-to-temp-key followed by `Compose(temp -> final)` and temp deletion the production path for large blobs. GCS `CompleteMultipartUpload` silently ignores `x-goog-if-generation-match`, while `Compose` enforces it; conditional writes therefore must not use multipart finalize, with unconditional multipart to a temporary key followed by conditional `Compose` as the production-grade large-blob path. canonical_claim: On GCS, non-numeric probe wrong tokens caused the dialect format guard to fail closed; LIST-derived MD5 ETags poisoned `If-Match` in GC and are disabled on generation stores; and `Expect: 100-continue` initially missed the dialect header, creating a B118-class stall risk. Three bugs were found and fixed while validating the GCS Generation binding end-to-end: (1) probe wrong-tokens were non-numeric, so the dialect's format guard killed the mount; (2) LIST-derived tokens on GCS are MD5 ETags (XML LIST bodies are not rewritten to generations), which would poison `If-Match` in GC, so list-derived tokens are disabled on generation-token stores; (3) the `Expect: 100-continue` handling did not recognize the GCS dialect header, creating a B118-class stall risk.

evidence.notes: The exact `If-Match` and `Expect: 100-continue` strings occur in CAS probe, GCS dialect, and HTTP-client code/comments.
